shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,90p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat index.html && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 26 '## Page Constructor' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button ThemeProvider && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -i -A 22 '"'^## .*page|''^## .*constructor'"' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button ThemeProvider; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -i 'header|card|extended|styles|Vite|action|content' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -55; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts; cat vite.config.ts; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs | head -45"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'IndentValue|ButtonTheme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/common.d.ts; rg -n 'title|renderTitle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/Header/Header.js | head -12; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks/ExtendedFeatures/ExtendedFeatures.js | head -65; rg -n 'include|filter|node_modules' node_modules/vite-plugin-dynamic-import/README.md | head -22; rg -n -- '--g-color-(base-utility|text-utility|text-dark-primary|text-light-primary|line-utility)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -16"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/url.js | head -65; rg -n '"'^@import.*~'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm --glob '*.css' | head -12; rg -n 'extraProps|variant' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -12; rg -n 'Text|ThemeProvider|Styles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -10"
